What you are opening

It is the Chatroulette format, pointed at men. Text rooms exist on some sites, and the video version is one stranger at a time until you skip.

The original Omegle shut down in November 2023, so any site wearing that name is run by someone else. Do not treat a familiar logo as the company you remember.

What a ban on those clones can and cannot do is in our how to get unbanned from Omegle page. The original service has nothing left to unban.

The same shutdown story is in this how to get unbanned from Omegle note. A download that promises to restore the old site is the scam.

Free, and what free still shares

Jerkay's homepage FAQ says the chat is free, with no hidden plan and no card. Our check of that claim matches the page, and the site does not explain how the free product is paid for.

The hands-on version is our Jerkay review. Fast and accountless is the pitch, and the age check is the part to read twice.

No registration means no email and no password. It does not mean no data, because the start form still asks for gender, your age, the age range you want, and optional countries.

Jerkay's privacy policy, last updated in June 2023, is the document that says what is kept. Read it on the day you visit, because a free site can change a policy without sending you a letter you never signed up to receive.

The homepage talks about anonymous age verification with no ID, no name and no email. In at least one session the flow offered a face scan or an ID scan through a third party, which sits awkwardly next to the no-ID line, so watch the screen you are actually on.

There is rarely an app

Search results promise a gay random video chat app, and the adult sites in this category mostly open in the browser. Jerkay is one of them, with nothing to install.

Apple's review rules say apps that are mainly random or anonymous chat do not belong on the App Store. A store listing that looks like Omegle is a reason to be suspicious, not a reason to feel safer.

If you would rather watch a moderated performer than meet a stranger, start from live cams. That is a different product, with tokens instead of a skip button.

Our are cam sites safe page is the billing and camera version of the same caution. A tip grid and a roulette room fail in different ways.

The ranking site's are cam sites safe guide makes that split as well. Do not pay a roulette site that suddenly asks for a card in the chat.

Habits that keep a session safer

A match is not consent. Ask before you go explicit, and stop if he skips, goes quiet, or says no.

Keep your face out of frame until you want it there, and keep identifying objects out of the background. Assume any frame can be saved, because the other person has a phone.

Sharing someone's intimate images without consent is abuse and can be a crime. Recording without consent can break the law where either of you is, so do not record.

You must be 18 or older, which Jerkay's terms state in plain language. If the person on the other side might be underage, skip and report, and do not keep the chat going to check.

Sites that replaced Omegle, including the no-login ones, are listed in this best free Omegle alternatives with no sign-in roundup. Free and instant is the category, and moderation quality varies wildly.

An outside list of Omegle alternatives is the second opinion. Expect to skip a lot, and leave any room that feels off.

Our Chaturbate review is the performer-grid alternative if random strangers are not what you wanted. You will pay in tokens there, and your camera can stay off.

Verdict

Use a site that says it is for adults, keep the first minutes clothed and faceless, and skip early. Free and accountless is a real convenience, and it is not anonymity.

Do not install a random-chat app from a link, and do not record the other person. Report anyone who might be under 18, and close the tab.

FAQ

Is gay random video chat free?

On Jerkay, the site's own FAQ says yes, with no card and no premium plan. Other roulette sites vary, so read the page you are on before a payment box appears.

Do I have to make an account?

The gay roulette sites people actually use often start without an email. You can still be asked for an age, a gender and a country, and the connection itself can be logged.

Is there an official app?

The sites we looked at run in the mobile browser. Apple's rules push random anonymous chat out of the App Store, so treat a download link as a warning.

Is Omegle back?

No. The original service closed in November 2023.

Anything using the name now is a different operator.

Can I record the chat?

Do not record someone without consent. That can be illegal where you are, and it is a rotten way to treat a stranger.

A screenshot of your own screen is still a copy of his body.
